lines: Hezbollah–Israel conflict The Ghana Army says that Battalion 92 of the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon will return to Ghana following a year of duty in southern Lebanon. (Ghana Web)
Russo-Ukrainian war Russia attacks a train bound for Warsaw, Poland at Yahodyn railway station. (BBC News)
Sinking of the Virgo Transport 8 Six people die, 97 are rescued and 140 remain missing after the sinking of the Virgo Transport 8 ferry in the Java Sea, Indonesia. (BBC)

Sinking of the MV Matui One person dies, 12 are rescued, and more than 30 remain missing after the sinking of the MV Matui ferry off Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu, during rough seas. (The Guardian) (Radio New Zealand)

Myanmar's Union Government revokes Kyaw Moe Tun's status as the country's permanent representative to the United Nations, accusing him of illegal activities, as the UN Credentials Committee prepares to consider the country's disputed representation. (AFP via France 24)

2026 Swedish general election Swedes vote to elect all 349 seats of the Riksdag. Incumbent prime minister Ulf Kristersson, who seeks to lead the Moderates to a second consecutive government while including the right-wing populist Sweden Democrats in his cabinet, is being challenged by the former prime minister and SAP leader Magdalena Andersson. Preliminary results indicate that the Red-Greens and the Centre Party are projected to have a combined total of 175 seats, while the four Tidö parties are projected to have a total of 174 seats. (AP) (DW)

Kosovo political deadlock The Assembly of Kosovo is declared constituted by acting president and speaker Albulena Haxhiu, but without the deputy speaker from the PDK. The Assembly then accepts the fourth cabinet of incumbent prime minister Albin Kurti. The PDK and the AAK both challenge the legitimacy of Kurti's government at the Constitutional Court. (AP) (Reuters)

2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup In basketball, the United States women's team defeats France 97–79 in the final to win the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup in Berlin, Germany, further extending their lead of 12 total wins. (USA Today)
American player Breanna Stewart is awarded MVP of the tournament, while Belgian player Emma Meesseman is the top scorer, averaging 21 points per game. (FIBA Basketball) (FIBA)
2026 Formula One World Championship 2026 Spanish Grand Prix In Formula One racing, Kimi Antonelli wins the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring in Madrid, Spain. (ESPN)
2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship British middle-distance runner Josh Kerr wins the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in the 1500 metres event. (The Independent)
